ASELSAN CEO Ahmet Akyol
   2   0   2   6   |   3   r d   Q   U A R T   E R
                                                                evaluated the financial results for the third quarter of 2026
                                                               “We are building a faster, more agile, and more competitive ASELSAN.”

                                                               “2026 is not just a year in which ASELSAN has grown, it is the year we redefined the very scale of our growth. The transformation unveiled through aselsaneXt is evident across
                                                               every dimension of the company: from order intake to investments, from production capacity to technological depth. We have moved beyond meeting today’s requirements we are
                                                               building the capabilities today to answer tomorrow’s challenges. Guided by the vision of a faster, more efficient, and globally dominant ASELSAN, we are shaping the future with
                                                               purpose and precision.

                                                               In addition to steady growth, our growth rate is also accelerating. Looking at our third quarter growth figures in USD terms, we grew by 18% in 2024, 29% in 2025, and 42% in this
                                                               year. We are performing far above our sector’s global averages in growth and across many business volume indicators. In August, we climbed three positions to rank 40th in Defense
                                                               News’ Top 100 list, and became the first Turkish defense company ever included in the Forbes Global 2000. Similarly, leading global investment institutions are increasingly
                                                               highlighting ASELSAN’s achievements in their reports.

                                                               “We are not only measuring growth by its scale but by its quality.”

                                                               We increased our revenue by 28% in real terms compared to the same period last year, reaching TL 151.5 billion, and improved our EBITDA margin by 190 basis points. This
                                                               improvement was driven by the effective use of Artificial Intelligence in our processes, the impact of digital transformation, and the growing share of higher value-added products in
                                                               our portfolio. As our scale expands, the enhancement of our operational margins is particularly valuable demonstrating not only that we are delivering more work, but also that we are
                                                               executing higher-value work more efficiently. We are not only measuring growth by its volume, but by its quality. Achieving a more efficient structure while becoming a larger company
                                                               is one of the most significant indicators of the transformation, we aim for through aselsaneXt.

                                       Ahmet AKYOL             “We are converting orders into capacity, and capacity into the future.”
                                       CEO                     ASELSAN has set new records in order intake, surpassing USD 30 billion in backlog for the first time in our history. New export contracts rose by 34% to USD 1.9 billion. The book-to-
                                                               bill ratio climbed to 4.4 a key indicator of the substantial order pipeline extending well into the future. This ratio reflects not only the strength of current demand but also the significant
                                                               growth potential ahead. Securing orders far above sales volume signals a robust and sustained workload in the years to come. Our primary responsibility moving forward is to convert
“Production has begun at Oğulbey.”                             this portfolio into timely deliveries, expanded production capacity, and sustained technological superiority.

We increased our investments in capacity expansion and high-technology infrastructure by 228%, reaching USD 684 million. We have launched the first phase of the Oğulbey Technology Hub the largest single-phase defence industry investment
in the history of the Turkish Republic. As we bring online new facilities such as the Guided Ammunition Systems Production Center, we are also advancing our robotics and automation infrastructure. Our approach is clear: we do not wait for
orders to outpace our capacity. Instead, we anticipate future demand and build our infrastructure today. We are converting orders into capacity and capacity into the future.

“We will continue to focus on emerging technology domains.”

We are investing in technologies of the future, ranging from satellite systems and quantum computing to underwater systems and high-power microwave and microelectronics technologies. We unveiled our low orbit satellite concept for the first
time at the International Space Congress held in Antalya. ASELSAN which has provided Turkish Armed Forces’ communications on land, at sea and in the air since its founding, will now also provide satellite communication services. Our project,
named ASTRALINK, has drawn significant international attention. We will continue to focus on these emerging technologies to strengthen our technological sovereignty, elevate our export competitiveness, and open new capability frontiers.

“We are maintaining our financial stability.”

Maintaining financial discipline while executing our investments remains one of our top priorities. We have invested nearly twice the amount of last year’s total capital expenditure within the first nine months of this year. Despite this acceleration in
investment pace, we have successfully preserved our financial stability. We have kept our debt-to-assets ratio at 14%, while reducing financing costs by 10.3%. Our return on equity has risen to 16.6%, and return on assets has reached 9%. As
we rapidly scale our capacity, we are simultaneously safeguarding our financial flexibility. This balanced approach provides a solid foundation for making future investment decisions with confidence and long-term resilience.

“We view global interest as a strategic development.”

Today, interest in ASELSAN and the systems we develop is growing steadily both in Türkiye and in international markets. We view this rising global attention as a strategic development. In an era where defence budgets are increasing and
nations are placing greater emphasis on supply chain security and technological sovereignty, ASELSAN’s broad and advanced product portfolio represents a significant competitive advantage. It is our corporate governance philosophy and our
highly skilled, dedicated workforce that have brought ASELSAN to this milestone. Our objective is clear: to establish ASELSAN as one of the world’s leading defence technology companies and a powerful global technology brand.”
